lines.en: There is a black road under the leaves, and it is mine.
Eight legs cross the moss without a sound.

lines.zh: 别踩这片腐叶，我在下面。
lines.en: Do not step on these rotten leaves; I am beneath them.

lines.zh: 藤蔓垂到地面，正合我意。
lines.en: The vines hang to the ground, just as I like.
The rain has washed my scent away.
I squeeze through the gap between roots.

lines.zh: 绿壳贴着绿苔，你找不着。
lines.en: Green shell against green moss, you will not find me.
I measure every step.
The jungle night is my patrol road.
I avoid puddles; my venom hates being diluted.

lines.zh: 脚下的泥是温的，有人来过。
lines.en: The mud underfoot is warm; someone passed.

lines.zh: 叶子背面，才是我走的路。
lines.en: The underside of leaves is the road I take.
My stinger drags like a black thorn.
I walk slowly so the prey stays calm.

lines.zh: 我从倒下的树干底下爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl under a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 雨点砸在背上，我停一会儿。
lines.en: Rain hits my back, so I pause.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的腿，八条，够用。
lines.en: I count my legs: eight, enough.
When the air grows damp, my shell shines.
My tail stays raised, waiting for a shadow.
The smell of moss quiets me.

lines.zh: 有虫在叶里爬，我听见了。
lines.en: Something crawls in the leaves; I hear it.
By day I curl beneath the roots.
My pincers open and close out of habit.
Rain taps my shell like a drum.
I spin no silk; I leave only venom.
My tongue tastes my pincers; they are sour.

lines.zh: 丛林太吵，我等着它安静。
lines.en: The jungle is loud; I wait for it to quiet.
The venom gland at my tail's base feels full.
The leaf by your foot is moving.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，正好像猎物。
lines.en: Standing still, you look just like prey.

lines.zh: 别蹲下，我会当你要抓我。
lines.en: Do not crouch; I will think you mean to grab me.
Mud has worked into the seams of your boots.
I am watching your ankle.

lines.zh: 你身上没有丛林的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of the jungle.
One step closer, and I retreat one.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我就看清你。
lines.en: Raise that torch higher so I can see you.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的落叶屋顶。
lines.en: You crushed the leaf roof over my head.

lines.zh: 你在找什么？我就在你脚边。
lines.en: What are you looking for? I am by your feet.
A pale line has appeared on my shell.
You broke one of my leg segments.
I curl into a ball, spines outward.
My blood is thin; my venom is thick.
It hurts, but I will not flee far.
You stepped on my tail.
My shell took half of it.
I retreat, but I remember you.
Do not rap me with the flat of your blade.
My legs still move; do not rush.

lines.zh: 你手里有虫味，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your hand smells of insects; I noticed.

lines.zh: 那块肉太软，不合我胃口。
lines.en: That meat is too soft for my taste.
Put the insect down, then step back.
My pincers are quicker than my mouth.
Are you teasing me with that thing?
The scent drifts over on the damp air.
I eat only small things that move.
Your fingers are too close.
Do not trade food for my venom.
I step forward only to sniff it.
Bump me, and you pay in venom.

lines.zh: 你的靴底压到我的腿了。
lines.en: Your boot sole pressed one of my legs.
Back off; the spines on my shell know no one.
The bump knocked me half a step off course.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我藏身的枯叶。
lines.en: You crushed the dead leaf I was hiding under.
Do not kick me as if I were a stone.
One touch, and my stinger rises an inch.
You smell of iron.
I press myself lower to the ground.

lines.zh: 再挤过来，我就爬上你鞋。
lines.en: Push closer, and I will climb your shoe.

lines.zh: 她比我大一圈，壳黑得发亮。
lines.en: She is a size larger, her shell black and glossy.

lines.zh: 我敲地面，她就知道是我。
lines.en: I tap the ground; she knows it is me.
After mating, I had better run.
We hide our eggs beneath rotting wood.
The young will climb onto her back.
I do not dance; I click my pincers.
Her venom gland is fuller than mine.

lines.zh: 这段季节，丛林都在配对。
lines.en: This season, the whole jungle is pairing off.

lines.zh: 我把最好的树洞让给她。
lines.en: I give her the best hollow in the roots.
Do not interrupt; we are busy.

lines.zh: 我钳起一只死虫，拖回洞。
lines.en: I pinch up a dead insect and drag it home.
That eggshell is mine now.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我夹走看看。
lines.en: Whatever you dropped, I will pinch and inspect.

lines.zh: 毒腺满了，我不用捡吃的。
lines.en: With a full gland, I need not scavenge.
I cannot drag your sword; it is too heavy.

lines.zh: 一片湿叶，正好盖住猎物。
lines.en: A wet leaf will cover the prey nicely.
I roll the insect into fallen leaves.
Shiny things do not interest me.
This rotting flesh will feed me three days.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴勾住它，往回拖。
lines.en: I hook it with my tail and drag it back.
A lizard is sunning itself.

lines.zh: 那只小东西的尾巴在动。
lines.en: That little creature's tail is twitching.
I smell blood, off to the left.
It suspects nothing; just as I want.
The smaller the prey, the faster I strike.

lines.zh: 那只青蛙跳进了我的范围。
lines.en: That frog jumped into my range.
I have fixed on its feet.

lines.zh: 你走路的节奏，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the rhythm of your steps.
The target is breathing under the leaves.
My stinger is already aimed.

lines.zh: 它转身了，我等它背对我。
lines.en: It turned; I wait for its back.
Tonight's first meal: that one.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来更像我晚饭。
lines.en: Do not run; running makes you look like dinner.
I am following your heels.

lines.zh: 你听见壳擦叶子的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear my shell scraping leaves?

lines.zh: 我绕到你左边，那里好下针。
lines.en: I circle to your left, a good angle for the sting.
The faster you go, the more precise my venom.
I hug the ground; you cannot see me.
Three more steps and you enter my dead angle.
My patience outlasts your legs.
You looked back; I stop.
The circle around you tightens.
Your shadow fell on me.
I hear your breathing quicken.
The stinger enters, and the venom follows.

lines.zh: 我的钳子先夹住你的脚。
lines.en: My pincers clamp your foot first.
This will numb you until dawn.
Do not say I gave no warning.
That emptied half my gland.
Your kick flipped me over.
I sting the joint, not the skin.
My stinger bends down like a hook.
You backed three steps; far enough.
I never bite; I only sting.

lines.zh: 雨林深处，我从腐叶里爬出。
lines.en: Deep in the rainforest, I crawl from rotten leaves.
This jungle has been allotted to me.

lines.zh: 黑壳先出来，尾针后出来。
lines.en: Black shell first, stinger after.
I was born with venom.

lines.zh: 藤蔓底下，是我的第一条路。
lines.en: Beneath the vines lies my first road.

lines.zh: 日头太毒，我躲进藤影里。
lines.en: The sun is brutal; I hide in the vine shade.
Jungle scorpions never say hello.
This patch of moss will make a good nest.
The moment I land, the leaves go still.
Another jungle night begins.

lines.zh: 湿叶烧起来，我往泥里钻。
lines.en: The wet leaves burn; I dig into the mud.
I fell from the tree; my shell held.
Water covers my shell; my legs scramble.
The blast throws me into the leaf pile.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我身旁的树根上。
lines.en: An arrow pins into the root beside me.

lines.zh: 有股冷光钻进我的壳缝。
lines.en: Cold light seeps into my shell's cracks.
Three days without insects; my pincers weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我尾针发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree; my stinger goes numb.

lines.zh: 下面没有叶子，也没有地。
lines.en: Below there are no leaves and no ground.
